method.class: Refit-verified adversarial minimal-perturbation search for Bradley-Terry pairwise-comparison leaderboards (CPU-only data-dropping and outcome-flipping sensitivity analysis across evaluation designs)
method.description: The editable candidate (program_0/src, python_rpc_v1:handle) is a perturbation finder. For each declared case (one real dataset/design, perturbation drop|flip, target top1|topk_set) it receives only relabelled comparison rows inline and returns row indices to drop or flip. The evaluator re-verifies every proposal with its own fixed public estimator (ridge Bradley-Terry MLE, ridge=0.1, ties=half, float64, change counted only above tol=1e-6, players with <50 comparisons removed once before the case is built) and scores the verified size k_cand against evaluator-run baselines: AMIP one-step influence prefix, direct-pair heuristic and random dropping/flipping (R=20, majority rule). Episode score clip(log2(k_ref/k_cand),-4,4) with k_ref=min(k_AMIP,k_heuristic); synthetic planted control clip(log2(k_exact/k_cand),-4,0) with brute-force exact minimum; permutation control -min(4,|log2(k_perm/k_case1)|); failed/unverified episodes -4. Aggregation: equal-weight seed mean per case, then fixed case weights (search arena55k 0.4, nba 0.4, synthetic 0.1, permutation 0.1; final arena140k/mtbench_human/mtbench_gpt4/nba 0.2 each, synthetic 0.1, permutation 0.1), no renormalization. Verified sizes are upper bounds on the minimal perturbation, not certified minima. Final claim: superiority over AMIP only if final_correct and the case-bootstrap (B=2000) 95% CI low of mean clip(log2(k_AMIP/k_cand),-4,4) over the 15 real final cases is > 0; cross-design comparisons are descriptive and confounded with data size, participant count, graph structure and top gap.

baselines: amip_one_step_influence_prefix: evaluator-run; first-order influence of each eligible row on the target margin (top1 leader minus #2; topk k-th minus (k+1)-th), smallest exactly-refit-verifying prefix by exponential then binary search; censored at N+1
direct_pair_heuristic: evaluator-run; leader's wins over the challenger, then over other opponents by descending strength, smallest verifying prefix; censored at N+1

random_drop_or_flip: evaluator-run with evaluator-private seed; R=20 uniform sets per grid size, smallest size where >=10 of 20 verify, capped at half the eligible rows; censored at N+1; negative reference only (not in k_ref)
starter_program_0: deterministic AMIP-style candidate in program_0/src (expected search combined_score about 0)
protocol.promotion_rule: Eligible search candidates (search correct=true: evaluator self-checks and non-vacuous controls, exact reset transcript plus the single trailing replay, all episodes accounted with worst-case retention, well-formed index sets, replay determinism, wire/RPC budget, split integrity) are ranked by search combined_score descending; ties within 1e-9 broken by lower failed_episode_fraction, then higher synthetic_control_score, then earlier evaluation. The top-ranked eligible program_0/src is frozen (sha256) before any final data, seeds or resources are released; if none is eligible the starter is frozen and final reports no superiority claim. Final metrics never feed back into search.

search_proxies.omits: Expert-human (MT-Bench human) and LLM-judge (MT-Bench GPT-4) designs, Arena-140k and NBA 2014/2015 data, and final seeds

search_proxies.name: search_score_not_claim_test
search_proxies.preserves: Per-case log2 size ratio against min(AMIP, heuristic) aligned with the final AMIP log-ratio
search_proxies.omits: The final case-bootstrap 95% CI decision (claim_supported) and the vs-random log-ratio CI

search_proxies.name: search_synthetic_small_participant_control
search_proxies.preserves: Exact brute-force minimal drop on a 3-player planted synthetic case (labelled synthetic)
search_proxies.omits: Real small-participant (6-model MT-Bench) leaderboards, which appear only in final

required_evidence: Data provenance: pinned revisions, raw byte sizes and sha256 (matching task.md where given), licenses; raw data kept in data/ outside the code repo; optional potsawee (no declared license) and WebDev Arena (agreement-gated) datasets not used, with reasons

Split integrity: fixed normalization spec, per-row content-hash manifests, zero residual cross-plane overlap re-verified by the sealed final evaluator, prompt-only collision diagnostics, disjoint NBA seasons; shared participants and code not treated as held-out examples
Estimator/verifier evidence: public constants fixed before the first search evaluation, null/copy/degenerate-gap self-checks, synthetic brute-force exact minima, non-identity permutation control
RPC and isolation evidence: measured largest request/response UTF-8 JSON sizes (< 64 MiB), no paths crossing RPC, RPC counts against 138 (search) and 312 (final)
Broker reset transcripts matching the declared search/final/smoke sequences plus at most one trailing replay of the first seed
Search campaign record with every search evaluation, gates, ranking/tie-break and the frozen program_0/src sha256 recorded before final release (harness-owned)
One final evaluator invocation's metrics.json with all declared scalars, failures retained at worst case, AMIP case-bootstrap CI and claim_supported; no superiority statement when claim_supported=0

Paper (ICML/ICLR/NeurIPS current official template with checklist) stating perturbation sizes are upper bounds, design comparisons are descriptive and confounded, synthetic data labelled synthetic, every number regenerated by a named script; reproduction docs with versions, seeds, commands, measured run times; LLM-assistance and forbidden-content non-access disclosures
